evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This call will just take around ten to fifteen minutes then I'll be able to build you an accurate code you can depend on. Sounds good. [No real pause/wait for affirmation — rep moves straight to next question.]
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep jumped directly into logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floors (4th and 3rd), bedrooms (1 to 2), walking distances (all four measured: 20ft, 20ft, 30ft, 20ft), additional stops (storage unit, 5x10, half-full, indoor, Dallas location), special items (none, no heavy equipment, no valuables, no appliances).
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: And do you need our help packing your small items into boxes? Or will you be able to do it yourself?
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked as a specific overflow check. Rep mentioned typical $15–$25 range for a one-bedroom but did not ask about china, books, or collections that might exceed typical count.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: For a typical one bedroom apartment, it usually takes around two and a half to three and a half hours... In your case... I will estimate this move to take around four and a half to five and a half hours with two movers and one truck. And it's good to budget around $918 to $1,122. [Anchored to typical range and personalized to customer's specific logistics: fourth floor, storage unit, third floor destination.]
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: We charge $204 per hour... Everything is included in the hourly rate, like the fuel and truck taxes, insurance... there are no hidden fees of any type... We have a minimum of two and a half hours once we go over the minimum, the time is pro rated in fifteen minute increments.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. After pricing, customer asked for clarification ('What was your price overall?'), rep repeated it, then rep moved straight to email/booking without ever asking 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: We have on time guarantee if we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange. We immediately start discounting money of your final bill and the way the clock work is the time start as soon as we get on site and open the contract.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: We have no worries, damage coverage, we provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages. [Mentions $2,000 and coverage concept, but does not explicitly state 'no deductible' or 'no fine print' framing.]
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. After presenting Two Promises, rep never asked 'Does that put those to rest?' or any closing confirmation on the guarantees.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: And do you have any questions or anything for me? [Empty throwaway phrasing, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' version.]
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' appeared.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Would you like our help with your move?
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: To secure a spot, there's no deposit required if you have to reschedule, or cancel no fees for that either.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Rep offered email follow-up ('I'll be sending you an email for this. Once you decide to book with us you can just reply to my email, or give us a call') but never confirmed date, phone, arrival window, crew size, or addresses, and left no notes about customer concerns.

top_strength: Nicole gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, all four floor-to-door distances, storage unit specs, bedroom count) and delivered a fully personalized estimate ($918–$1,122 for 4.5–5.5 hours) anchored to typical ranges and grounded in the customer's specific move profile.
coaching_note: Ask 'What are your biggest concerns about this move?' before any probing, and after pricing, ask 'Does that feel fair?' and hold the silence — Nicole skipped both, which cost discovery of the customer's real agenda and the chance to land the objection handling when it matters most.
